Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 20 ORIGINAL distinct Wuxia/Xianxia ore inventory icons on a TRANSPARENT atlas, later split into individual icons. Exactly 4 equal columns by 5 equal rows (20 cells); portrait canvas ratio 4:5. Every cell contains ONE isolated rough ore specimen, centered, about 70% of its cell, with large completely transparent margins. No shared objects, neighboring fragments, borders, labels, letters, numbers, symbols, backdrop, floor, cast shadows or opaque tiles. Transparent background across whole canvas, preserve alpha. Hand painted gouache fantasy game item art with broad simplified brush shapes, few details, clear readable silhouettes, gentle shading, restrained highlights. Same consistent medium and apparent scale for every icon; NOT photos, NOT realistic glossy 3D gems, NOT vector flat art. Each specimen must have its own shape, color, mineral matrix and vein pattern. These are raw mined materials, not refined bars, not jewelry, not beast cores or essence orbs. Keep colors muted but distinguishable on a dark charcoal game sheet. Higher-level specimens may be wondrous but NO large glows, auras or particles. IMPORTANT follow exact row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1): flat rusty red hematite rock plates, dark iron patches.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2): knobby malachite ore, broad emerald and pale green concentric bands.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3): pale river rock with dark brown blocky cassiterite crystals.
Cell 4 (row 1, column 4): heavy graphite gray galena ore with large stepped cubic faces.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 1): irregular black magnetite, a few tiny iron filings attached at edges.

Cell 17 (row 5, column 1): fan of thin pearly mica sheets embedded in warm brown rock.
